title: Juicy Crisp Australian Pork Skewers
description: A keto-friendly Australian dish featuring sake and namul-blanch-seasoned pork, perfect for a quick and easy dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sake, coconut aminos, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Roll the pork skewers in crushed pork rinds to coat.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through and crispy on the outside.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
